description: Move an open slot to another later day of the calendar (after the week ahead, within the horizon). To bring one into the week ahead, write its full task under its key with work_plan instead. Say why in plain words. It needs an act key.

date.description: Its new day, YYYY-MM-DD: after the week ahead ends, on or before the horizon's end.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

reason.description: Why it moves, in plain words; the owner reads it.

name: slot_move
title: Slot move
